job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the frame (job) that requires the task. Matches one of the entries in the 'frame_ids' list.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the processing step within the frame's sequence (1 = first step cutting, 2 = assembly, 3 = stitching). Tasks must occur in this order for each frame.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the station required for this task (one of the 'station_ids'). Indicates which physical station will perform the step and enforces that the station cannot process two frames simultaneously.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The time needed to complete this task on its required station (e.g., minutes). Used to compute start/end times for tasks and to determine the overall makespan when all frames finish.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of parts/items in this production run (the number of jobs the supervisor must schedule through stamping, assembly, and inspection).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct workstations available in the shop (typically the stamping press, the assembly station, and the inspection station); each workstation can handle only one item at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each part/item in the batch (each identifier corresponds to one job that must go through the three operations in order).

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the machines/workstations in the shop (e.g., 'stamp', 'assemble', 'inspect' or numeric IDs that map to those stations) used to assign tasks to specific stations.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific part/item being scheduled (must match one entry from item_ids).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the operation in the fixed sequence for each item (1 = stamping, 2 = assembly, 3 = inspection); defines the order tasks must be performed for that item.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the workstation required for this operation (maps to one of the workstation_ids such as the stamping press, assembly station, or inspection station); that station can process only one item at a time.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required for that item on the specified workstation (time units for the schedule); this time is continuous, cannot be split, and must be fully allocated on the station without overlap.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of parcels that must be processed this dispatch run. This tells the solver how many job sequences (parcels) to schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of sequential workstations each parcel must visit (for this scenario normally 3: scanning, labeling, sorting). Defines the length of each parcel's processing route.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each parcel to be scheduled (e.g., P1, P2...). Each identifier corresponds to one job whose tasks must be ordered and scheduled.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Ordered list of workstation identifiers in the fixed processing sequence (e.g., scan, label, sort). The order here is the required processing order for every parcel.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the parcel this task belongs to; must match one entry from parcel_ids so the solver groups tasks into the correct parcel's sequence.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Ordinal index of the processing step for this parcel (1 = first step, 2 = second, etc.). It indicates the position in the fixed scan→label→sort sequence and enforces that a parcel's steps occur in order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the workstation required for this task; must match one entry from workstation_ids and indicates which station (scan/label/sort) will perform the task.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time required for this parcel at the specified workstation (in the same time units across all tasks). Used by the solver to ensure workstations don't process overlapping parcels and to compute the makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of code changes (work items) that must go through the pipeline; i.e., how many separate changes you need to schedule from compile → test → deploy.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of sequential pipeline stages (distinct machine roles) in the build pipeline. In this scenario these correspond to the ordered stages (for example: compile, test, deploy).

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each code change to be built; each identifier names one job that must pass through every pipeline stage in order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of pipeline stage identifiers (the 'machines') in the exact processing order the changes must follow, e.g. ["compile", "test", "deploy"]. These define which stage each task requires.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific code change this task belongs to; links a task to its parent change.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the task within the change's sequence (the pipeline step position). Values indicate the ordered step (e.g. 1 = compile, 2 = test, 3 = deploy) that must follow the pipeline order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the pipeline stage (build agent role) required for this task, matching one entry from pipeline_stages (for example "compile", "test" or "deploy").

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed processing time that this change will occupy the given pipeline stage. All durations use the same time unit and determine how long the build agent is busy for that task.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of cans in today's batch — the number of jobs (each can must go through all steps).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct processing stations on the line (e.g., sterilization, filling, sealing); each station can handle at most one can at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for each can (job) in the batch; these are the items to be sequenced down the line.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the stations (machines) in the fixed processing order (for example: sterilizer, filler, sealer).

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the specific can (job) this task belongs to, matching an entry in can_ids.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the processing step within the can's fixed sequence (1 = sterilization, 2 = filling, 3 = sealing); tasks must follow increasing step_index for each can.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the required station for this step (which of the stations the can must visit at this step).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time the can spends at that station for this step (in consistent time units). This is the uninterrupted processing length used to schedule non-overlapping use of each station.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of appliance units that must be repaired and scheduled; each unit is a job that will go through diagnosis, parts replacement, and final testing.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct workbenches or stations in the shop (e.g., diagnosis bench, parts-replacement bench, final-testing bench). Each station can process at most one unit at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the appliance units to be scheduled (the jobs). These IDs link each unit to its sequence of steps and durations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the shop stations (machines). These are the benches used in the common processing order (diagnosis → parts replacement → final testing) and are referenced by task entries.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the appliance unit (must match one of unit_ids). Used to group the sequence of steps that belong to the same unit.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the step in the unit's workflow (1 = diagnosis, 2 = parts replacement, 3 = final testing). All units share this ordered set of steps.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the station (bench) required for this step; must match one of the station_ids and indicates which workbench must be reserved for the step.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required for this step on the given station, expressed in the schedule's time units (for example, minutes). The station is occupied for this continuous duration when processing the step.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of casserole dishes that must be prepared, baked, and cooled — the count of separate jobs you need to schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct shared stations (appliances) involved in the workflow, e.g., the prep station, the oven, and the cooling area; each can handle only one casserole at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers (names or indices) for each casserole dish so you can refer to them when planning start times for their steps.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of appliance identifiers corresponding to the shared resources (for example ['prep_station','oven','cooling_rack']), used to indicate which appliance each step requires.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the specific casserole this task belongs to (must match one entry from casserole_ids).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of the task in the casserole's fixed sequence of steps (e.g., 1 = prep, 2 = bake, 3 = cool); steps must occur in this order for each casserole.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Which appliance is required for this step (must be one of the appliance_ids, e.g., 'oven' for the baking step); indicates the shared resource that cannot be used by two casseroles simultaneously.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: How long this step takes for the casserole, expressed in consistent time units (minutes); used to determine when the appliance will be free for the next casserole.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of loaves (jobs) that must pass through the bakery pathway (mixer → oven → glazing); this is the size of the batch to schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of shared equipment stations in the fixed processing sequence (here: the mixer, the oven, and the glazing bench); each station can handle only one loaf at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of loaf identifiers to be scheduled (one entry per loaf); these IDs are referenced when assigning each loaf's tasks to stations in order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of station identifiers in the pathway order (e.g., ['mixer','oven','glazing']); these names identify the equipment required by each task.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the loaf that this particular task belongs to; corresponds to one entry from the 'loaves' list.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of this task within the loaf's fixed processing sequence (1 = mixing, 2 = baking, 3 = glazing); tasks must be executed in increasing step_index for each loaf.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the station (equipment) required for this task (e.g., 'mixer', 'oven', 'glazing'); only one loaf may occupy the station at any time.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time required for the loaf to be processed at the specified station for this task (in the chosen time units); used to compute start/finish times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of booklet batches that must be processed through the shop; each represents one job that will go through printing, then trimming, then binding.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct processing stations in the workflow (e.g., printing, trimming, binding); each station can handle at most one batch at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the booklet batches (jobs). Use these IDs to refer to each batch's sequence of tasks through the three stations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the shop stations (machines) involved in the workflow, given in the common processing order (printing → trimming → binding) or as available station names.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the booklet batch this task belongs to (matches one entry from 'booklet_ids'), linking the task to a specific job.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The position of this task in the job's fixed sequence of operations (1 = first step/printing, 2 = second/trimming, 3 = third/binding).

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the required station for this task (must match one of 'station_ids'); indicates which shop machine (printing, trimming, or binding) will process the task.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The processing time (in the time units used by the schedule) required for the batch at the specified station; used to compute task start/end times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of green bean loads that must pass through the line (each load is one job to schedule).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of processing stations in the shared sequence (for this scenario: roast, cool, pack → typically 3).

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers (labels or indices) for each green bean load that will be ordered through the roast→cool→pack sequence.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the processing stations in the line (e.g. 'roast', 'cool', 'pack' or numeric IDs preserving the common order).

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the specific green bean load this task belongs to (links the task to its load).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the processing stage for the load (1 = first stage = roast, 2 = cool, 3 = pack), keeping the common order each load follows.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the station required for this task (must match one of the station_ids; each task requires that single station in the sequence).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time required for the load at that station (the processing length for that task); used to compute start/finish times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of plastic pieces (parts) that must be processed through the three stations (molding → trimming → inspection). This is the count of jobs the supervisor must schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of sequential workstations in the plant that every part must visit (typically 3: molding, trimming, inspection). Represents how many machines operate in the fixed order.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each plastic piece to be scheduled (e.g., part IDs). Each identifier links that piece to its sequence of stage tasks and durations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the workstations in the consistent processing order (for example: 'molding', 'trimming', 'inspection'). These are the machines that perform the stages for every part.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the specific plastic piece this task belongs to (matches one entry from 'parts'). Used to group the three stage tasks for the same piece.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The index of the processing stage within a part's route (1 = first stage: molding, 2 = second: trimming, 3 = third: inspection). Preserves the required order each part must follow.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Which workstation performs this task (one of the stations: molding, trimming, inspection). Indicates the resource that must be free to start the task.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The time required for this part at the specified station (in the chosen time units). This is the processing length scheduler must allocate while ensuring no station handles more than one part at a time.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of platters to prepare — the count of jobs that must each go through making, chilling, and staging.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct work stations available (assembly/making, chilling, staging). This is the number of machines in the flow; each station can serve only one platter at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: The list of identifiers for the platters (jobs). Each identifier names a platter to be scheduled through the three stations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the stations (machines) in the shared processing order (e.g., assembly, chilling, staging). Tasks reference these ids to indicate where they must be processed.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the platter that this task belongs to; must match one entry from platter_ids.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the task within the platter's sequence (1 = first step: making/assembly, 2 = chilling, 3 = staging). Determines the platter's internal processing order.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the station required for this task, matching one of the station_ids (assembly, chilling, or staging).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time required (in the instance's time units) for the platter to be processed at the given station. Used to compute start/finish times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of trays that must pass through the kitchen route. This is the number of jobs to schedule so every tray completes prep, warming, and serving.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Count of distinct stations along the common route (e.g., prep, warming, serving). Each station can handle at most one tray at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: An ordered list or set of identifiers for each tray to be scheduled. These labels identify each tray as it moves through the stations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the stations along the route (for example: prep, warming, serving). The sequence of these stations defines the common processing order for all trays.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the tray this task belongs to; matches one entry from the tray_ids list.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the step within the tray's fixed sequence (e.g., 1 = prep, 2 = warming, 3 = serving). Indicates the order of tasks that the tray must follow.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the required station for this step (one of the station_ids). Specifies which kitchen station must process the tray at that step.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Processing time required for the tray at this step (duration at the given station). Used to compute start/finish times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of tabletops in the lot that must each be processed through cutting → sanding → finishing; this is the count of jobs to schedule.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct workshop stations (e.g., cutting, sanding, finishing) available; each station can process at most one tabletop at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Ordered list of tabletop identifiers (one per job) representing each piece that must pass through the three operations.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of station identifiers corresponding to the workshop machines in the shared processing order (cutting, sanding, finishing).

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier that associates a specific task with a particular tabletop (must match an entry in 'tabletops').

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of the operation within the tabletop's fixed sequence (1 = cutting, 2 = sanding, 3 = finishing); enforces the per-tabletop order of tasks.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the required station (from 'stations') where this operation must be performed; indicates which machine the task occupies.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Time required to perform this operation on the specified station (same time unit across all tasks); used to compute start/end times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of biological samples that must be processed in this batch. This tells the scheduler how many jobs (samples) need to go through centrifuge, incubator, and assay.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Number of distinct pieces of equipment/stations involved in the prescribed processing sequence (e.g., centrifuge, incubator, assay). Each equipment can handle only one sample at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the samples to be scheduled. Each identifier refers to one sample that must pass through every stage in the same machine order.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers for the machines/stations in the required processing order. In this scenario they represent the centrifuge, then the incubator, then the assay (the same order applies to every sample).

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the sample that this task belongs to (matches one entry from sample_ids).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Index of the processing step within the sample's sequence (e.g., 1 = centrifuge, 2 = incubator, 3 = assay). Steps must occur in increasing step_index order for each sample.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the required equipment/station for this task (must match one entry from equipment_ids). This tells which piece of equipment the step must use.

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The time the sample requires on the specified equipment for this step. All times use the same unit as given in the instance; durations determine scheduling and cannot be split or overlapped on the same equipment.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of toys that must pass through the line (count of jobs to schedule).

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: The number of sequential work stations on the line (here: priming, painting, varnishing = 3).

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: An ordered list of identifiers for each toy (job IDs) that the supervisor can choose an overall processing order from.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifiers or names of the stations in the fixed processing route, in their processing order (e.g. [priming, painting, varnishing]).

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The unique identifier for a single toy (which the supervisor schedules through the three stations).

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The index of the task inside a toy's sequence (1 = first operation: priming, 2 = painting, 3 = varnishing), indicating its position in the route.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the required station for this task (which station must process the toy at this step: priming/painting/varnishing).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: The processing time required for this toy at the specified station (same time units throughout); used to compute start/finish times and the overall makespan.

global_fields.name: nr_jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of phones (handsets) in the current batch that must be scheduled through the line; the supervisor must sequence and time this many jobs so all pass through every station.

global_fields.name: nr_machines
global_fields.scenario_description: Count of distinct workstations in the fixed processing route (screen fitting, casing press, final check). This is the number of machines that can each process at most one phone at a time.

global_fields.name: jobs
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for each phone in the batch (e.g., Phone1, Phone2). These IDs are used to refer to each handset when defining its tasks and scheduled times.

global_fields.name: machines
global_fields.scenario_description: List of identifiers for the workstations in processing order (e.g., ScreenFitting, CasingPress, FinalCheck). Each identifier denotes a shared station that can handle one phone at a time.

job_task_item_fields.name: job_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the phone (from phone_ids) to which this task belongs; groups the sequence of tasks that a handset must follow.

job_task_item_fields.name: task_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Position of the task within the phone's fixed route (1 = screen fitting, 2 = casing press, 3 = final check), indicating the order that must be respected.

job_task_item_fields.name: machine_id
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the required workstation (from station_ids) for this task; the task can start only when that station is available and idle (one phone at a time).

job_task_item_fields.name: duration
job_task_item_fields.scenario_description: Fixed time required to perform this task on the specified station (e.g., minutes). This determines how long the station is occupied and contributes to the makespan.
